items.title: ActiveCloud (Belarus) cloud infrastructure encrypted
items.summary: Belarusian cloud provider ActiveCloud disclosed a ransomware attack on Nov 11 that encrypted parts of its infrastructure and disrupted hosted websites, email and virtual servers; most services were restored by Nov 13 and the company reports no evidence of customer data theft.

items.title: Nota Groep listed as ransomware victim
items.summary: Transportation firm Nota Groep appeared on a leak-site tracker on Nov 10 attributed to the Ransom group; the claim is not yet confirmed by the company.

items.title: Leware Construction claimed by Storm-1567
items.summary: US construction/manufacturing company Leware Construction was listed by the Storm-1567 group with an attack date of Nov 11; unconfirmed by the victim.

items.title: Everest posts 'final notice' for new victim
items.summary: The Everest group posted a pre-publication notice for an unnamed victim with an attack date of Nov 13, signalling an imminent data leak.

ransomware.note: Thin named-victim coverage this cycle; three of four items are leak-site claims from an aggregator and not yet victim-confirmed.

items.title: Microsoft 365 outage (EX1550543 / MO1550821)
items.summary: Microsoft 365 users saw significant Outlook/Exchange disruption on Nov 12–13, tracked as incidents EX1550543 and MO1550821; no corresponding Azure platform incident was listed.

outage.note: No confirmed AWS or Google Cloud outages found for November 2026 so far.

items.title: CISA adds GPUStack, FreeSWITCH, OpenSSH, IBM Aspera Faspex to KEV
items.summary: CISA added four actively exploited vulnerabilities to KEV on Nov 9 with an unusually short Nov 12 federal remediation and forensic-triage deadline.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure flaws hit KEV deadline
items.summary: Two Ivanti Connect Secure vulnerabilities carried a Nov 13 KEV remediation deadline amid active exploitation of VPN edge devices.

items.title: Zyxel switch zero-day used to hijack 996 devices
items.summary: Attackers used a new Zyxel zero-day, CVE-2026-107441, to take over 996 network switches, per an early-November threat brief.

items.title: Apple flaw added to KEV over APT29 iPhone targeting
items.summary: CISA added an Apple vulnerability exploited by APT29 against older iPhones to KEV with an 18 November due date.

items.title: M 6.6 earthquake, 148 km WSW of Tual, Indonesia
items.summary: A magnitude 6.6 quake struck the Banda Sea region on Nov 16; USGS issued a green PAGER alert and no tsunami was generated.

items.title: Spokane, WA wind-driven wildfires
items.summary: Three fast-moving wildfires around Nov 2 damaged or destroyed nearly 1,000 buildings in the Spokane area.

items.title: Cyclone Murasu landfall, Andhra Pradesh
items.summary: Cyclone Murasu made landfall on the Andhra Pradesh coast on Nov 3, the second cyclone to hit that coast in under a week.

items.title: Brazil and Ecuador flooding emergencies
items.summary: Brazil recognized emergencies in 44 municipalities across 13 states and Ecuador reported 12 deaths and about 56,000 people affected by flooding in early November.

physical.note: Atlantic hurricane season quiet; most natural-hazard reporting found dates from early November.
